throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.

comparison cell.

may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.

use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

Interpretive frame: dependency scores are continuous and more negative values indicate stronger CRISPR dependency. Returned estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction, so I interpret signed positive values as supporting the registered hypothesis and signed negative values as opposing it. Because dependency outcomes can be negative, I used approximate 10%-of-absolute-population-mean clinical-scale benchmarks: roughly 0.042 for dependency_SMARCA2, 0.030 for dependency_WRN, 0.030 conservative for dependency_DHX9, 0.028 for dependency_STAT3, 0.027 for dependency_MDM2, 0.018 for dependency_USP7, and 0.009 for dependency_NFE2L2. Acceptance required a meaningful point estimate and an interval that reasonably excludes null and a clinically meaningful opposite effect. All conclusions are dataset-specific associations, not causal, therapeutic, or externally generalizable claims.

Supported main findings:
1. SMARCA4 loss is associated with much stronger dependency_SMARCA2. This is the strongest and most repeatedly supported result. Direction -1 acceptances mean SMARCA4-loss lines have more negative SMARCA2 dependency. Effects are approximately 0.75-0.82, far above the 0.042 benchmark, with independent validation support in H31/R40 and broad robustness across lineage, screen quality, Cas9 activity, ploidy, IFN, EMT, slow growth, MYC expression, PTEN loss, and ARID1A-loss contexts. 2. KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency_NFE2L2. This was established by the reversal and validation in H22/R6 and R26. Direction +1 acceptances mean KEAP1-loss lines have less negative NFE2L2 dependency. Effects are approximately 0.77-0.81, far above the 0.009 benchmark, with robustness in adenocarcinoma, high screen quality, high Cas9, low Cas9, ploidy, IFN, EMT, stemness, PTEN-loss, and TP53-loss or TP53-intact contexts. Effects are approximately 0.37-0.45, well above the 0.018 benchmark, with independent validation in H8/R39 and additional validated or robust contexts including H112/R92 and R93 among KEAP1-loss lines and H45/R216 among KEAP1-intact lines. The association persists across high and low Cas9, high screen quality, ploidy, AXL high expression, MYC high expression, IFN, EMT, Avana library, and multiple exclusion contexts. Again, this is an association in this dataset, not a causal TP53 effect.

Effects are approximately 0.10-0.14, above the 0.027 benchmark in many accepted contexts: TP53-intact, TP53-loss, MTAP-intact, high Cas9, low Cas9, high screen quality, high and low ploidy, high mutation-burden with screen-quality refinement still active, and Avana high-ROC. This association has not been independently validated because validation budget is exhausted, but it is internally replicated across many technical and genomic contexts. H209/R185 in MTAP-intact lines reduces concern that the effect is purely an MTAP or 9p21 co-deletion surrogate, though MTAP interaction remains unresolved and mechanism remains unproven.
